notes.title: Version 0.5 Updated
notes.content:
Version 0.5 updated to reflect my active state of mania
[list]
[*]Weapon freelook overhaul. Completely innovated video game freelook functionality for the first time since 2006
[*]Playtest scene layout updated to be more obscure and guide the player even less than before
[*]Lots of little fixes in preparation for the demo build
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 0.5 Hotfixes
notes.content:
The build is now relatively playable for testing purposes. 

Known Issues:

[list]
[*]Tracking images might freeze in place when you crash the suit, preventing the laser from registering any new signatures for the encyclopedia. Restarting will fix this
[*]Settings screen is finnicky. Rebinding has a bad feel and the Apply button doesn't do anything
When in doubt, press escape
[*]Some sound effects are not mixed very well in relation to universal volume controls
[*]The level does not have any ending or way to exit the level. You are stuck there as a playtester to conduct experiments
[/list]
